gitobject.Short (name[:min(len(name), 12)]) behaves the same as the removed review.ShortName and pipkg.shortSHA for every length, and Candidate.Short keeps its empty result for a head shorter than 12. names.go now reads gitobject.ShortLength, which is 12 as before.

checkScript order is Stat (ErrNotExist or ENOTDIR means not deployed, any other error means cannot be checked), then a regular-file check, then Open. Because os.Stat follows symlinks, a symlink to a FIFO gets the not-regular error before the open, so it cannot block the hook. A deployed regular, readable script still reaches the run as before.
